children: ESDS Software Solution shares more than doubled on their debut on Friday, rising more than 111 percent from its initial public offering (IPO) price.
The shares were locked in a 20 percent upper circuit at Rs 908.40 per share on the National Stock Exchange (NSE), up 111.75 percent from the issue price.

Shivani Nyati, Head of Wealth at Swastika Investmart, recommended that existing allottees consider booking partial profits at current levels and maintain a stop-loss around Rs 650-680 on the remaining holding.
"Investors without allotment would be better served awaiting a pullback toward Rs 600-650 before evaluating a fresh entry," she added.
The shares were listed at Rs 757 on the NSE, a premium of 76.46 percent over the issue price. The Rs 720-crore IPO had a price band of Rs 408-429 per share.
On the BSE, the shares were listed at Rs 746.30 apiece, a premium of 73.96 percent.
The company's market capitalisation rose by Rs 1,899.99 crore to Rs 10,647.44 crore from Rs 8,747.45 crore after the rise in the share price.
The listing followed strong demand in the primary market, with the IPO receiving 136 times subscription during the August 28 to September 1 bidding period.

"The rising demand for cloud computing, data-centre infrastructure, cybersecurity and digitalisation in India provides a favourable structural growth opportunity for ESDS over the long term," Nyati said, supporting a constructive medium-to-long-term view even after the listing-day gain.
However, she cautioned that given the scale of the listing-day gain, some near-term profit-taking is likely as valuations have run ahead of fundamentals.

Dr. Ravi Singh, Chief Research Officer from Master Capital Services, noted that long-term investors may still find the underlying business relevant, with growing demand for cloud, data centers and AI infrastructure potentially supporting growth over the coming years.

"Investors who have received allotted shares may book partial profit and can keep the rest for the long term. On the other hand, those who did not get shares in the IPO may buy when the price comes down," he added.

It is one of only two players offering the full spectrum of GPUaaS, cloud, managed services, data centre infrastructure and software solutions and was the largest among them by FY26 revenue from operations of Rs 4,722.10 million. Its offerings include IaaS, managed services and SaaS, serving BFSI, Government and Enterprise customers, with 2,501 customers in FY26, Singh noted.

ESDS Software Solution plans to utilise Rs 576 crore of the IPO proceeds to purchase and install cloud computing and other equipment and infrastructure for its data centres. The remaining funds will be used for general corporate purposes.
